record.definition: unit-size-adjusted median resale $psf, Sep 2021–Sep 2023 against Oct 2024–Sep 2026

text.price: $2,266 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 3.
text.record: Prices rose 15% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 13% for developments with similar features in District 3 — about the same as similar developments.
infrastructure: Queenstown MRT, about 100 m (straight line to the nearest exit).
supply: 5 developments within 2 km are still selling, with about 165 unsold homes (URA developers' sales, Sep 2026).
text.demand: 93 resales in the last 24 months, in 24 of 24 months.
text.answer: Right by an MRT station and a large development. Resale prices are in line with similar developments in District 3.
